name: Improved Serrated Shot raises Serrated Shot's DoT modifier by 30% (#3160)
contract: 707888 'Improved Serrated Shot' reads 'Increases the damage of Serrated Shot by $s1%.' It is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 22 = SPELLMOD_DOT, BasePoints 29+1=30, class mask (0, 0, 128) = word2 bit 7. Serrated Shot rank 1 (500073) and rank 2 (501704) are both SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE with SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 128) = the same word2 bit 7, a direct, confirmed match (a third, unrelated 'Serrated Shot' record, 802038, has all-zero family flags and is not part of this chain). Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp) calls modOwner->ApplySpellMod(spellProto->Id, SPELLMOD_DOT, tmpDamage) unconditionally for every DoT tick, so no script is needed.
